development_baseline.name: v11 development predictions
development_baseline.recipe: v9 + 0.75 * v11 development residual (runs/adsb_v11/development_residuals.parquet, leave-one-month-out), floored; reproduces 333.914 / 277.689 / 200.421 on Jan / Jul / Nov 2025

configuration.development_scheme: leave-one-month-out over the three scoring months that hold out-of-sample v9 predictions (Jan and Jul 2025 from the seasonal fold, Nov 2025 from the forward fold); for each variant (scope, feature set) the residual model is fitted on the other two months' in-scope rows and applied to the held-out month's in-scope rows; every other row keeps v9

external_data.extraction: tools/adsb_extract_day.py keeps positions inside the ten aerodrome boxes that are on the ground or below 3,000 ft; per-day parquet with archive part hashes under data/external/adsblol/surface/ (the tool now skips and counts a corrupt archive member instead of aborting the day; the surface files used here predate that change and are unaffected)
external_data.license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0; feeder data CC0; licence files are inside every archive
external_data.matching: tools/build_adsb_features.py: ICAO callsign (CALLSIGN_flt, else FLIGHT_mvt) and takeoff within the track's ground-to-air transition; stand positions learned label-free from covered segments of Jan/Mar/Apr/Jul/Nov 2025 (1,111 stands); the pass-2 matches and stands are exactly the v11 inputs, snapshotted under data/external/adsblol/matches_v11/ and hash-bound below
external_data.source: adsb.lol globe_history daily archives (GitHub releases adsblol/globe_history_2025 and globe_history_2026, tags vYYYY.MM.DD-planes-readsb-prod-0)

configuration.floor_seconds_rule: minimum departure label over the refit months (-12), applied after the residual

incumbent.recipe: v11 = v9 + 0.75 * ADS-B surface residual on matched rows (configs/adsb_v11_v1.json, residual_matched_75)

configuration.prior_evidence: Declared after v11 (official 248.4368, 4th) and after the null result of configs/adsb_v12_v1.json (neighbour features on the matched or context scope: -0.12% / +0.18% / -0.00% versus v11 on Jan / Jul / Nov, nothing selected). Two facts motivate this declaration: (1) v11's own per-airport development table shows LIRF getting worse (+1.7% Jul, +0.4% Nov) while every covered airport improves, and a what-if on the recorded v11 development predictions with LIRF kept at v9 gives 333.914 / 275.630 / 200.126 (0.00% / -0.74% / -0.15%); (2) in the v12_v1 run the neighbour-feature model improved EDDF, EDDM, EHAM, LSZH and LEBL by 2-9% on the months with coverage but was cancelled by LIRF (+1.0% / +1.2%). The candidates therefore exclude LIRF from the residual scope, with and without the neighbour features, at weights 0.75 and 1.0. Expected size on the ranking: 0.2-0.6%.

residual_model.applies_to: the candidate's scope, for training and prediction alike; every row outside the scope keeps the v9 prediction exactly. LIRF is excluded a priori: its label is dominated by the documented BLOCK=SCHED fill artifact, the ADS-B pushback does not describe it, and v11 made LIRF worse on both months with coverage (+1.7% Jul, +0.4% Nov)
residual_model.prediction: v9 + weight * residual on in-scope rows, then floor
residual_model.rounds_rule: development: rounds per held-out month and variant (scope, feature set) come from a 5-fold day-grouped inner split of the two training months (median best iteration, 200 rounds patience, at most 4000); the held-out month is never used for rounds; export: median of the selected variant's three development round counts

scopes.matched_no_lirf: departures with a matched ADS-B surface segment at any airport except LIRF (adsb_matched == 1 and airport != LIRF); LIRF rows always keep v9

configuration.selection: For each candidate (scope, feature set, weight), RMSE of (v9 + weight * residual on the scope) on each held-out month versus the v11 development prediction on the same rows (all departures of the month). A candidate is eligible when it is not worse than v11 on ANY month (ratio <= 1.0; January is identical to v11 for the v11-feature candidates because LIRF has no January coverage) and its mean ratio over the three months is at most 0.997. Choose the eligible candidate with the lowest mean ratio to v11; otherwise select nothing. Ratios to v9, per-airport tables and the paired-day bootstrap interval of the RMSE difference to v11 are descriptive only.
